mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE WHERE STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT COURSE_ID AS courseId, COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, DESCRIPTION AS description, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, TOTAL_HOURS AS totalHours, CREATE_DATE AS createDate, UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM COURSE
WHERE ( COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY STATUS DESC, CREATE_DATE ASC
ORDER BY STATUS DESC, CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE(COURSE_ID, COURSE_TITLE, DESCRIPTION, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, START_DATE, END_DATE, TOTAL_HOURS, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (SEQ_CNO.NEXTVAL + 80, #{courseTitle}, #{description}, #{memberId}, 'W', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, (#{endDate} - #{startDate}) * 24, SYSDATE, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COURSE_ID AS courseId, COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, DESCRIPTION AS description, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, TOTAL_HOURS AS totalHours, CREATE_DATE AS createDate, UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM COURSE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
